realworld.enter.place.point.tip: Click on the area map to pick a place
realworld.enter.last_hint: You will appear where you left
realworld.enter.time.tip: "Like there now" puts the sun where it is right now at this place on Earth
realworld.enter.cinematic.tip: The camera spirals down to you from a bird's-eye view
realworld.library.extend.tip: Add a neighbouring area to the world: it lands in its real place
realworld.map.settings.tip: All world settings: profiles, city, terrain, zombies
realworld.option.zombies.tip: Zombie difficulty; more in the world settings
realworld.enter.zombies.tip: Zombies in this world; saved with the world
realworld.settings.title: World Settings
realworld.settings.locked: Set when the world was created; fixed when adding areas
realworld.settings.mode.tip: What to build: a city on real terrain, a flat city, nature only, or a blueprint with building outlines
realworld.settings.signage.tip: Street names, traffic signs and shop signs
realworld.settings.apocalypse.tip: A city after the catastrophe: ruins, overgrowth, abandoned cars
realworld.settings.scale.tip: Blocks per metre. 2× makes everything twice as big and four times slower
realworld.settings.height.tip: How much stronger hills and valleys are than in reality
realworld.settings.edges.tip: What lies past the area: grass plains or the void
realworld.settings.zombies.tip: The mod keeps a crowd of zombies around the player. Harder means more of them, faster, tougher and hitting harder
realworld.settings.density.tip: How many zombies are near the player
realworld.settings.no_burn.tip: Zombies don't catch fire in daylight
realworld.settings.hordes.tip: Twice as many zombies at night
realworld.settings.armoured.tip: Some zombies wear helmets and chestplates
realworld.settings.runners.tip: One zombie in five is much faster
realworld.profile.city.desc: The city as it is: buildings, streets, parks and real terrain.
realworld.profile.abandoned.desc: A city after the catastrophe: ruins and empty flats. Zombies roam and don't burn in the sun.
realworld.profile.wasteland.desc: A ruined city and many strong zombies: runners, armour, night hordes.
realworld.profile.winter.desc: Snow on roofs and streets, ice on the water, cosy interiors.
realworld.profile.flat.desc: A city without hills: easy to build in and travel.
realworld.profile.nature.desc: Terrain, water and forests without buildings or roads: a clean place for your own builds.
realworld.profile.blueprint.desc: Roads, water and nature, buildings as outlines only: a base to build the district yourself.
realworld.load.light.tip: A quarter of the cores, small pieces, low priority: the game stays smooth, building takes longer. For huge areas in the background.
realworld.load.balanced.tip: Half the cores, pieces sized to the free memory, lowered priority.
realworld.load.max.tip: Nearly all cores and large pieces: fastest, but the game may stutter.
realworld.generation.stop.tip: Finished pieces stay in the world; finish the rest from the library.
realworld.generation.hide.tip: Generation goes on in the background; you can play another world. A notification says when it is done.
realworld.library.finish.tip: %s of %s pieces left. Finish with the same settings.
realworld.enter.preload.tip: Prepare chunks before you enter: convert them to the game format and light them, so nothing stutters later. Done once; prepared chunks are remembered. "Off" enters at once without waiting. "Around" is the view distance, "far" 48 chunks, "whole world" the entire map (slow on huge ones). Esc while preparing skips it.
realworld.generation.zoom_hint: Wheel: zoom · drag: move · right click: reset
